description: Zero‑dependency, type‑safe Node.js framework that feels like Express, runs at Fastify speed, and ships native HTTP/2, edge‑runtime & AI‑augmented serverless support out of the box.
npm_trending_strategy: Version 0.0.195‑daily introduces native HTTP/2, edge‑runtime (Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge), and built‑in AI/LLM hooks, letting you write type‑safe TypeScript that runs at Fastify speed without any external dependencies. It’s positioned as the "Express‑like" experience developers love, but with the performance of Fastify and the modern edge‑first capabilities that dominate 2026 serverless workloads.
download_hooks: Developers choose Yantravese because it gives the familiar Express API while delivering Fastify‑class speed and zero‑dependency simplicity.
Performance‑first: native HTTP/2 + edge‑runtime means sub‑millisecond latency on Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge, and Bun/Deno runtimes.
Developer experience: full TypeScript typings, built‑in AI/LLM helpers, and plug‑and‑play observability make building serverless, AI‑augmented services frictionless.
